title: Find the Availability Zone of a NAT gateway
kills: "A NAT gateway serves every Availability Zone of a Region."
read_only_alternative: This task is read-only. It needs no alternative.

steps.text: List the NAT gateways of your current Region with the subnet of each NAT gateway.
steps.expect: A table with a row for each NAT gateway, or an empty table.

steps.text: Read the Availability Zone of that subnet. Replace <SUBNET_ID> with a subnet ID from the table.
steps.expect: The name of the Availability Zone that holds the NAT gateway.
